tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🏛️ Upper Town: * Begin your day wandering through Zagreb’s historic Upper Town — peaceful medieval alleys, charming corners and the iconic Stone Gate with its quiet shrine. → | 🎨 St. Mark’s Square: * Admire the famous tiled roof and colorful buildings surrounding one of the most photogenic squares in Croatia. → | 🕍 Zagreb Cathedral: * Visit the tallest building in Croatia — an impressive Gothic cathedral full of history and atmosphere. → | ☕ Coffee in Tkalča (Tkalčićeva Street): * Take a relaxed break in Zagreb’s liveliest café street — cozy terraces, colorful façades and a perfect morning vibe.; Afternoon: 🏙️ Lower Town Walk: * Explore the “Green Horseshoe” — a chain of elegant parks, tree-lined avenues, museums and grand Austro-Hungarian architecture. → | 🎭 Museum of Broken Relationships: * A unique and emotional museum filled with personal stories and surprising exhibits — quirky, moving and one of Zagreb’s cultural gems. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Local Specialties: * Try comforting favorites like štrukli, roasted turkey dishes, hearty soups, or vegetarian local options — warm and filling.; Sunset: 🌅 Bundek or Jarun Lakes: * Head to Zagreb’s favorite lake areas for soft sunset colors, calm water reflections and a peaceful golden-hour atmosphere.; Night: 🌃 Evening Walk Through the Center: * End your day with a gentle nighttime stroll — soft lights, dessert cafés, relaxed streets and a friendly city vibe perfect for unwinding.

tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🏛️ Diocletian’s Palace: * Begin your day inside the ancient Roman palace — a living labyrinth of stone arches, Peristyle square, narrow marble lanes and 1,700-year-old walls. The mix of history, life and atmosphere here is unbeatable. → | ⛪ St. Domnius Cathedral & Bell Tower: * Climb the tower for one of the best panoramas in Split — red rooftops, sea horizon and the full palace structure beneath you. A short climb with a huge reward. → | ☕ Coffee on the Riva: * Take a relaxed seaside break on Split’s iconic promenade — palm trees, boats, gentle waves and the best Mediterranean morning vibe.; Afternoon: 🏘️ Old Town Wander: * Explore the stone-paved alleys around the palace — tiny squares, artisan shops, hidden courtyards and local charm everywhere you turn. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Dalmatian Specialties: * Enjoy fresh seafood, buzara-style mussels, pašticada, grilled fish, or light Mediterranean veggie plates — all bursting with flavor and perfect for a coastal lunch.; Sunset: 🌅 Marjan Hill Viewpoint: * Hike or take an easy walk up to Marjan for Split’s legendary sunset — golden light over the city, islands in the distance and the sea glowing below you. One of the most magical views in Dalmatia.; Night: 🌃 Riva Night Walk: * End the day with a gentle stroll along the Riva — soft lights, music, gelato stands, sea breeze and a relaxed Mediterranean nightlife vibe perfect for unwinding.

tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🏛️ Roman Forum: * Begin your day at the ancient Roman Forum — marble ruins, open space and a calm old-town atmosphere that perfectly sets the tone. → | ⛪ St. Donatus Church: * Step beside the city’s famous round church — a unique pre-Romanesque landmark that dominates the square and makes for great photos. → | ☕ Coffee in the Old Town: * Relax in one of the street cafés nearby — slow Mediterranean morning, stone alleys and warm coastal vibes.; Afternoon: 🌊 Waterfront Walk: * Stroll along Zadar’s long stone promenade — sea breeze, clear water, boats and a peaceful, scenic atmosphere. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Dalmatian Dishes: * Enjoy seafood risotto, fresh pasta, grilled fish or light Mediterranean plates full of local flavors.; Sunset: 🌅 Sea Organ & Greeting to the Sun: * Experience Zadar’s world-famous sunset — waves playing music through the Sea Organ while the solar circle lights up as the sky glows orange and purple. A magical, must-see moment.; Night: 🌃 Seaside Night Walk with Gelato: * End your day with a gentle stroll by the sea — soft lights, warm night air, relaxing seaside sounds and the perfect gelato in hand.

tour_type.afternoon: 🏝️ Lokrum Island: * Nature, cliffs and peaceful wildlife. → | 🍽️ Lunch: * Mussels, risotto, or vegetarian pasta.

tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🧱 City Walls Walk: * Start your day walking Dubrovnik’s legendary stone walls — morning light, open sea views, terracotta rooftops and fewer crowds make this the perfect time. Every corner brings a new postcard moment. → | 🏰 Old Town Exploration: * Wander through marble-paved Stradun, narrow stone alleys, arches, small squares and historic buildings — the true medieval soul of Dubrovnik. → | ☕ Coffee on Stradun: * Take a break in one of the cafés along the main street — smooth stone pavement, elegant façades and lively morning charm.; Afternoon: 🏝️ Lokrum Island: * Take a short boat ride to the peaceful island paradise — pine forests, rocky cliffs, swimming spots, botanical gardens and friendly peacocks roaming freely. A perfect escape from the city buzz. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Dalmatian Favorites: * Enjoy mussels in buzara sauce, seafood risotto, grilled fish or light Mediterranean vegetarian dishes — fresh, coastal and full of flavor.; Sunset: 🌅 Fort Lovrijenac Viewpoint: * Watch the sun dip behind the Adriatic from the iconic fortress overlooking the Old Town — golden light over stone walls, waves crashing below and one of Dubrovnik’s most dramatic viewpoints.; Night: 🌃 Stradun Night Stroll & Gelato: * End the day with a relaxed nighttime walk through softly lit marble streets — music, warm sea breeze and a perfect gelato to finish your Dubrovnik adventure.

tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🕊️ Memorial Center: * Begin your day with a meaningful and reflective visit — carefully presented exhibits, stories and preserved spaces that offer important historical insight. A quiet, respectful start that sets a thoughtful tone. → | 🏛️ Eltz Manor: * Continue to the elegant baroque palace on the Danube — beautifully restored halls, cultural displays and a museum that tells the story of Vukovar through centuries. → | ☕ Coffee by the Danube: * Take a soft morning break at a riverside café — calm water, gentle breeze and peaceful surroundings.; Afternoon: 🌊 Danube Promenade: * Walk along Vukovar’s scenic riverfront — long pathways, benches, greenery and a relaxed rhythm perfect for unwinding. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Slavonian Specialties: * Enjoy hearty regional dishes like fiš paprikaš, čobanac, Slavonian stews, grilled river fish or vegetarian soups — warm, rustic and full of local flavor.; Sunset: 🌅 Danube Horizon Sunset: * Watch golden light melt over the wide river horizon — quiet, spacious and incredibly atmospheric. A simple but powerful sunset experience.; Night: 🌃 Calm Evening Walk Through the Center: * End your day with a peaceful stroll through Vukovar’s renewed central streets — soft lighting, gentle city ambience and a comforting, slow-paced night vibe.

tour_type.morning: 🏰 Ilok Castle: * Beautiful views over the Danube. → | 🍇 Wine cellars tour (non-alcoholic friendly): * Museum-like cellar walk. → | ☕ Coffee with a view.
tour_type.afternoon: 🌊 Danube Promenade: * Quiet riverside walk. → | 🍽️ Lunch: * Slavonian platters, soups, veggie dishes.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Ilok Castle: * Begin your day at the hilltop fortress overlooking the Danube — peaceful courtyards, sweeping river views and a strong historical atmosphere. A perfect, calm start to the morning. → | 🍇 Wine Cellars Tour (Non-Alcoholic Friendly): * Take a guided walk through Ilok’s famous medieval cellars — museum-like halls, old barrels, cool stone corridors and plenty of cultural storytelling. Even without tasting, the experience is rich and fascinating. → | ☕ Coffee with a View: * Enjoy a relaxing cup of coffee on a terrace overlooking vineyards or the Danube — soft breeze, slow rhythm and pure Ilok charm.; Afternoon: 🌊 Danube Promenade: * Take a quiet riverside stroll along Ilok’s peaceful promenade — wide horizons, greenery and a calming river atmosphere ideal for unwinding. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Slavonian Dishes: * Enjoy regional specialties like hearty soups, rustic platters, locally inspired veggie dishes or simple homemade meals that reflect Ilok’s traditional flavors.; Sunset: 🌅 Danube Horizon Sunset: * Watch the sky turn golden and pink over the wide Danube — tranquil, open and one of the most beautiful natural scenes in the region. Perfect for photos and slow moments.; Night: 🌃 Peaceful Old-Town Walk: * End your day with a quiet walk through Ilok’s small historic streets — soft lights, stone houses, total calm and a relaxing finish to a gentle Danube-side day.
